theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtfr_skeleton_decomposition
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Q₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact K → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q₀ → Q₀.support ⊆ K → Q₀.support ⊆ {x : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z} → ∃ (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (u : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, ∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, u p y = z) ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (u p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u p y|) ≤ Q₀.mass ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ Q₀.support) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q₀ ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))
